CREATE VIEW lease_with_isp_json AS
WITH isp_enriched AS (
  SELECT
    p.*,

    CASE
      WHEN p.TechCode = 50 THEN 'fiber'
      WHEN p.TechCode IN (40, 43) THEN 'cable'
      WHEN p.TechCode IN (60, 70, 71) THEN 'fixed_wireless'
      WHEN p.TechCode IN (10, 11, 12, 20) THEN 'dsl'
      WHEN p.TechCode IN (90, 91) THEN 'satellite'
      ELSE 'unknown'
    END AS tech_class

  FROM lease_provider_options p
)
SELECT
  l.*,
  COALESCE(
    (
      SELECT json_group_array(
        json_object(
          'dba', e.DBA,
          'tech_code', e.TechCode,
          'tech_class', e.tech_class,
          'service_type_raw', e.Service_Type,
          'best_dn', e.MaxAdDn,
          'best_up', e.MaxAdUp,

          'bucket',
            CASE
              WHEN e.tech_class = 'fiber' THEN 'best'
              WHEN e.tech_class = 'cable' AND COALESCE(e.MaxAdDn, 0) >= 1000 THEN 'best'
              WHEN e.tech_class = 'cable' THEN 'good'
              WHEN e.tech_class = 'fixed_wireless' AND COALESCE(e.MaxAdDn, 0) >= 100 THEN 'good'
              ELSE 'fallback'
            END
        )
      )
      FROM isp_enriched e
      WHERE e.listing_id = l.mls_number
        AND e.DBA IS NOT NULL
      ORDER BY
        COALESCE(e.MaxAdDn, -1) DESC,
        COALESCE(e.MaxAdUp, -1) DESC,
        e.DBA ASC
      LIMIT 8
    ),
    json('[]')
  ) AS isp_options_json
FROM lease l

CREATE VIEW lease_with_isp_json AS
WITH isp_enriched AS (
  SELECT
    p.*,

    CASE
      WHEN p.TechCode = 50 THEN 'fiber'
      WHEN p.TechCode IN (40, 43) THEN 'cable'
      WHEN p.TechCode IN (60, 70, 71) THEN 'fixed_wireless'
      WHEN p.TechCode IN (10, 11, 12, 20) THEN 'dsl'
      WHEN p.TechCode IN (90, 91) THEN 'satellite'
      ELSE 'unknown'
    END AS tech_class

  FROM lease_provider_options p
)
SELECT
  l.*,
  COALESCE(
    (
      SELECT json_group_array(
        json_object(
          'dba', e.DBA,
          'tech_code', e.TechCode,
          'tech_class', e.tech_class,
          'service_type_raw', e.Service_Type,
          'best_dn', e.MaxAdDn,
          'best_up', e.MaxAdUp,

          'bucket',
            CASE
              WHEN e.tech_class = 'fiber' THEN 'best'
              WHEN e.tech_class = 'cable' AND COALESCE(e.MaxAdDn, 0) >= 1000 THEN 'best'
              WHEN e.tech_class = 'cable' THEN 'good'
              WHEN e.tech_class = 'fixed_wireless' AND COALESCE(e.MaxAdDn, 0) >= 100 THEN 'good'
              ELSE 'fallback'
            END
        )
      )
      FROM isp_enriched e
      WHERE e.listing_id = l.mls_number
        AND e.DBA IS NOT NULL
      ORDER BY
        COALESCE(e.MaxAdDn, -1) DESC,
        COALESCE(e.MaxAdUp, -1) DESC,
        e.DBA ASC
      LIMIT 8
    ),
    json('[]')
  ) AS isp_options_json
FROM lease l
